title: Homepage Positioning
content: AltiusNxt positions itself as a trusted partner for B2B eCommerce product data enrichment services for industrial distributors, emphasizing scalable, accurate, and reliable execution.

title: Core Service Focus
content: The company's core public service areas include product data enrichment, product taxonomy services, product attribute development, PIM and MDM implementation, eCommerce consulting, platform integration, technical content writing, and eCommerce catalog management.

title: Industrial Specialization
content: AltiusNxt highlights deep experience serving industrial distribution sectors such as MRO, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and fluid power.

title: Platform Compatibility
content: The website states that AltiusNxt works with PIM and commerce platforms such as Pimcore, Akeneo, Stibo Systems, Salsify, Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, and BigCommerce.

title: AI and Automation Angle
content: AltiusNxt describes its delivery model as AI and automation driven for faster turnaround while still emphasizing accuracy, quality, and reduced manual effort.

title: Accuracy Proof Theme
content: The company claims it can handle large datasets and maintain 99%+ accuracy as catalogs grow.

title: Company Scale and History
content: The public site describes more than two decades of expertise in product data enrichment for industrial distributors and a multi-region presence across the Americas, Europe, EMEA, and APAC.

title: Public Proof Points
content: Public testimonials reference large-scale catalog onboarding and product data projects, including examples such as 10,000+ product onboarding support and improved inquiry or conversion outcomes tied to richer data.

title: Careers Messaging
content: The careers page emphasizes an innovative culture, growth opportunities, work-life balance, and an open call for talent to share resumes for future opportunities.

title: Public Contact Information
content: Public contact routes include US and India office presence, sales@altiusnxt.com for sales inquiries, and the careers page lists shivanie@altiusnxt.com for resume submissions plus a job inquiry phone number.
